label: T-shirt/top
summary: Short-sleeved upper-body garments, crewneck tees, and sleeveless tops characterized by open necklines and compact sleeve silhouettes.
silhouette_clues: Short or absent sleeves with curved shoulder seams
Compact torso rectangle narrower at the shoulders than coats
Open crew, scoop, or V-shaped neckline without collar flaps
common_confusions: Shirt (when front plackets or collars are faint at 28x28)
care_and_construction: Typically knitted cotton or jersey fabrics forming smooth edges in 28x28 grayscale projections.

label: Trouser
summary: Full-length bifurcated legwear including slacks, jeans, and tailored pants with a clean central leg split.
silhouette_clues: Distinct vertical bifurcation separating left and right pant legs
Horizontal waistband at the top edge with minimal upper flare
Uniform narrow vertical silhouette from hip to cuff
common_confusions: Dress (very narrow column silhouettes in rare cases)
care_and_construction: Tailored or denim legwear; the clean central gap makes Trouser one of the highest-accuracy classes.

label: Pullover
summary: Long-sleeved knitted sweaters, sweatshirts, and crewnecks pulled over the head without a full front opening.
silhouette_clues: Full-length sleeves angled outward or downward beside the torso
Continuous solid chest surface without central button placket
Ribbed cuffs and waistband edges visible as soft brightness transitions
common_confusions: Coat (similar long-sleeve coverage, usually shorter hem on pullovers)
Shirt (similar silhouette, though shirts often show collars or front seams)
care_and_construction: Knit wool, fleece, or cotton blends that produce dense, uniform grayscale textures.

label: Dress
summary: One-piece upper-and-lower garment ranging from fitted sheaths to flared A-line skirts and sundresses.
silhouette_clues: Extended vertical torso-to-skirt silhouette spanning full frame height
Waist taper often followed by a wider flared or pleated lower hem
Sleeveless, cap-sleeve, or narrow-strap upper neckline
common_confusions: Coat (long coats share vertical height, though coats have wider sleeves)
care_and_construction: Woven or draped fabrics creating strong contrast between narrow waist and flared skirt.

label: Coat
summary: Heavy outer garments including trenches, overcoats, blazers, and parkas with structured shoulders and long sleeves.
silhouette_clues: Long sleeves paired with an extended lower torso or mid-thigh hem
Structured collar, lapels, or vertical front closure seam
Heavier shoulder line and thicker sleeve profile than knit pullovers
care_and_construction: Structured wool, tweed, or lined outerwear with sharper lapel and cuff edges.

label: Sandal
summary: Open-profile footwear with straps, open toes, or elevated heels showing negative space inside the upper.
silhouette_clues: Open cutouts and thin straps against the background
Distinct sole/heel contour often tilted along a diagonal
Sparse pixel density across the instep compared to sneakers or boots
common_confusions: Sneaker (low-profile side views with dense straps)
Ankle boot (heeled boots sharing arch geometry)
care_and_construction: Strappy leather or synthetic footwear where high-frequency edges distinguish straps from closed uppers.

label: Shirt
summary: Collared button-down shirts, blouses, and long- or short-sleeved woven tops—historically the hardest FashionMNIST category.
silhouette_clues: Pointed collar tips framing the top center neckline
Subtle vertical placket or tonal shading down the center front
Varied sleeve lengths bridging T-shirts, pullovers, and coats
common_confusions: T-shirt/top (short-sleeved button-downs share almost identical outlines)
Pullover and Coat (long-sleeved shirts overlap heavily without local convolution filters)
care_and_construction: Woven cotton or linen; spatial CNN filters outperform flat MLPs by detecting collar lapels and center seams.

label: Sneaker
summary: Closed low-top athletic and casual shoes oriented horizontally in side profile with a flat sole and laced upper.
silhouette_clues: Horizontal side profile facing left with flat continuous rubber outsole
Low ankle collar well below the mid-height of the frame
Solid filled upper body without strappy cutouts
common_confusions: Ankle boot (high-top sneakers share shaft height with low ankle boots)
care_and_construction: Canvas, leather, or synthetic mesh uppers atop sculpted cushioned midsoles.

label: Bag
summary: Handbags, totes, satchels, clutches, and backpacks featuring rectangular or rounded bodies with top handles or straps.
silhouette_clues: Compact rectangular, trapezoidal, or semicircular main compartment
Arched top handles or diagonal shoulder strap loop above the body
Absence of sleeves, leg openings, or shoe sole geometry
common_confusions: Rare overlap with folded tops when handles are faint
care_and_construction: Leather, canvas, or structured textiles; distinctive handle loops yield high separability.

label: Ankle boot
summary: Closed shaft footwear rising above the ankle, including Chelsea boots, combat boots, and heeled booties.
silhouette_clues: Tall vertical shaft extending from the heel into the upper half of the frame
L-shaped overall silhouette combining toe box and ankle cuff
Visible heel block or lugged sole along the bottom edge
care_and_construction: Leather or suede shaft construction clearly captured by multi-scale spatial pooling.
